decisions.reason: Transferring active prize tickets with a resold NFT does not change the flat secondary-sale royalty or its enforcement.
The resale transfer rule does not change the collection's unlimited-mint NFT ebook model.
The existing metadata requirement already displays the ticket counters; transfer of the NFT and its active tickets does not change which metadata fields must be visible.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already updates resale_copy to state that active prize tickets transfer to the purchaser.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already captures that buyers who acquire active tickets with a resold NFT join the eligible ticket-holder population.
Ticket transfer on resale does not alter the primary mint price, founder share, commission share, or prize-pool destinations.
The source changes later ownership of active tickets, not their initial allocation after a mint without a referral code.
The source does not change when referral tickets are issued, how many are issued, or their initial assignment to the referrer's NFT.
Transfer of active tickets does not change the winners-page one-click claim mechanism or establish a different prize-delivery mode.
The NFT's mint-number referral identity and its resale behavior remain unchanged; the source adds transfer of a separate prize-ticket state.
Active Big Block tickets remain subject to the same eligibility window and post-draw reset after transfer; no Big Block parameter changes.
Active Small Block tickets remain subject to the same eligibility window and post-draw reset after transfer; no Small Block parameter changes.
